# `upload`

Helper: `upload({ text, btn, file, status, preview })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): web-only (kit gap; `Field` type file is the nearest) · status: kit gap (web-only)  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaCheckRow` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Dashed box: camera icon, hint, "Chọn ảnh" button, chosen file name, status line, optional synthetic preview with the tag "MINH HỌA TỔNG HỢP".

## Variants

- Empty
- File chosen with status
- With preview

## States

- Empty: dashed line-strong border
- Chosen: file name 600 and status micro

## Tokens

field, line-strong, ink-soft, ink, brand-100, brand-500, radius-card

## Do

- Say the file is kept for the demo session when it is

## Don't

- Never preview a real photo

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Preview 180 x 120.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Send-update file chooser: dashed box, camera icon, hint, "Chọn ảnh" button, chosen file name, status "Đã chọn: … (đã giữ trong phiên demo)", synthetic preview placeholder with the "MINH HỌA TỔNG HỢP" tag when `preview`
